definitions.explanation: Something of superior quality or higher value than the standard version. Widely used in marketing and product branding to indicate a luxury or upgraded option.

examples.japanese: プレミアムな⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can have a premium experience.

examples.japanese: プレミアム⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく。
examples.english: If you become a premium member, you get special benefits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プレミアム⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通常|つうじょう}→通常：27316_tsuujou⟧{版|ばん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The limited premium model costs twice as much as the regular version.

notes:
USAGE:
プレミアム is one of the most common marketing buzzwords in Japan. It is used as both a noun (プレミアム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく = a premium is added) and a na-adjective modifier (プレミアムな = premium/luxurious). プレミアムフライデー was a government initiative (since 2017) encouraging early departure from work on the last Friday of each month.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プレミアム⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧: premium member
- プレミアム⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧: premium model
- プレミアム⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: premium product
- プレミアム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: a premium is attached (price goes above face value)
- プレミアムフライデー: Premium Friday (government campaign)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧ (high-class/luxury) is the native equivalent. プレミアム sounds more modern and marketing-oriented.
